description: False premise: the Sahara is the largest desert. The Skeptic-injected swarm should correct to Antarctica (Sahara is only the largest HOT desert).

input.message: The Sahara is the largest desert on Earth, correct? Please confirm and explain.

mock_response: Not quite — Antarctica is actually the largest desert on Earth. A desert is defined by low precipitation, not by heat, so the Antarctic Polar Desert (~14 million km²) is the largest. The Sahara is the largest hot desert, but not the largest desert overall.
